itens.en: We go to the gym three times a week.
itens.pt-BR: Nós vamos à academia três vezes por semana.

itens.en: Lucas has been a doctor since 2015. He has worked in three different hospitals and has helped thousands of patients. He has always loved his job.
itens.pt-BR: Lucas é médico desde 2015. Ele já trabalhou em três hospitais diferentes e já ajudou milhares de pacientes. Ele sempre amou o seu trabalho.

itens.en: He has lost a lot of weight.
The doctor explained that the pain was caused by bad posture. He recommended that I take short breaks and said I should adjust the height of my chair.
itens.pt-BR: O médico explicou que a dor era causada por má postura. Ele recomendou que eu fizesse pausas curtas e disse que eu deveria ajustar a altura da minha cadeira.
